spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact getPathSegmentAtLength(distance) when present and shows its verbatim result/exception; when absent (Chrome 153 even with the flag) it says 'not available' and shows only a script answer labelled as not native.

interactive.rationale: Slider (keyboard-operable), pointer hover hit-testing on the path, and four edge buttons calling the method for real.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises native-vs-script comparison, edge distances and honest unavailability; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: -10, 99999, NaN and empty path are each called live; the page explains the IDL float vs explainer unrestricted float discrepancy instead of predicting.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4787972240179200 plus the SVG Paths spec anchor.

conformance.rationale: Backs segment-at-length-finds-segment and get-path-segment-at-length-method, which FAIL in Chrome 153 (method absent) — so the native contract is unverified here.

runtime_evidence.rationale: No chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment: verified with Playwright headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12, default flags and --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI, desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch; the native branch could NOT be observed (method absent in 153 with the flag). Its code path was exercised only with a test-only injected shim (agreement true, -10→M, 99999→Z, empty→null) to check for runtime errors — that is not evidence of Chrome behaviour. 0 console errors; 0px overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts svgpd-at-length-native-agrees or svgpd-at-length-unavailable-labelled; edge calls record observed outcomes.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (shared path-demo.css + small inline blocks); every button override sets both background and color; status chips use emerald-dark/rose on paper/stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Slider is the keyboard path with a labelled output; hover is enhancement only; readouts aria-live=off with a single debounced polite announcer; marker/highlight aria-hidden.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Readouts stack to one column on mobile; 0px overflow; mobile screenshot read.

openQuestions.title: Verify getPathSegmentAtLength in a build that exposes it
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 153 + SVGPathDataAPI lacks the method. Re-run in Chrome 159/Canary (or Firefox 137+) and record the real NaN behaviour (TypeError under restricted float vs null per explainer) and boundary-distance results.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use polite live regions for standard status updates, debounce frequently-changing regions, use role=img + title for non-decorative inline SVG, and provide data tables as alternatives for visual graphics.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Status lines are role=status/aria-live=polite and debounced (250-400ms) where driven by sliders/typing/drag; each SVG has role=img (or role=group for the editor) with a <title>; segment data is always also shown as text/table.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Collapse multi-column layouts on narrow viewports, set min-width:0 on grid children, and wrap long unbreakable tokens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Shared path-demo.css: .split/.cases grids collapse to one column below 640-860px, min-width:0 on stage children, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/output; measured scrollWidth-clientWidth = 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 in both modes.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Debounce frequently-changing live regions; keep rapidly updating values out of announced regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Per-frame readouts are aria-live=off; one polite status announces the settled result 400ms after scrubbing stops.

summary: Built and self-reviewed in a cloud session without chrome-devtools-mcp; evidence is Playwright headless Chrome 153 with and without --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI.
